suppress.notes: False positive: these CVEs affect the Elasticsearch server product (CPE cpe:2.3:a:elastic:elasticsearch), not org.elasticsearch:elasticsearch-tdigest (a small, standalone t-digest percentile algorithm library extracted from the Elasticsearch project and pulled in transitively via gatling-charts-highcharts for report generation). Incorrect CPE match on shared vendor/product name "elasticsearch". file name: elasticsearch-tdigest-*.jar

False positive: CVE-2017-1000034 affects Akka's Remoting component (java deserialization RCE), not org.scala-lang.modules:scala-parser-combinators. Incorrect CPE match on shared Scala/Lightbend ecosystem vendor association. file name: scala-parser-combinators_2.13-*.jar

Incorrect CPE match on shared vendor name "gatling". file name: gatling-shared-cli-*.jar / gatling-shared-model_2.13-*.jar / gatling-shared-util_2.13-*.jar

False positive: CVE-2026-54133 affects jmespath.php, not io.burt:jmespath-jackson (an unrelated Java library that happens to share the "jmespath" project name). file name: jmespath-jackson-0.6.0.jar

CVE-2026-66299 is a DoS in Apache Tomcat's WebSocket *examples* web application only. We use embedded Tomcat (tomcat-embed-core/tomcat-embed-websocket) via Spring Boot, which does not package the examples web app, so this is not exploitable here. Fixed version 11.0.25 is not yet published to Maven Central at time of suppression; re-review and upgrade tomcat-embed-* once available. file name: tomcat-embed-core-11.0.24.jar / tomcat-embed-websocket-11.0.24.jar
